consoles.title: Consoles
consoles.description: SSH, Telnet and read-only database consoles, connected through a local proxy that runs on your machine.
consoles.setupHint: Set up and test the local proxy under Settings → Proxy server.

services.mysql: Run SELECT queries on MySQL / MariaDB

page.title: {{service}} Console
page.terminalDescription: Open a {{service}} terminal in your browser through the local proxy. Your credentials never leave your machine.
page.queryDescription: Run read-only SELECT queries on {{service}} through the local proxy. Your credentials never leave your machine.

gate.outdatedTitle: Your local proxy is too old for this console
gate.downText: This console connects through a small helper on your own machine. Start it, and this page connects automatically.
gate.outdatedText: The running proxy doesn't support this service. Update it to the latest version and restart it.

saved.title: Saved connections
saved.empty: Connections you use will appear here.
saved.note: Only host, port and username are saved — never passwords or keys.

form.credentialsNote: Credentials are sent only to your local proxy and are never stored.

errors.websocket: WebSocket error — is the proxy still running?

terminal.telnetWarning: Telnet sends everything — including passwords — unencrypted. Use it only on trusted networks.

query.readOnlyNote: Read-only console: only SELECT (plus WITH, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) is allowed. For real protection also use a read-only database account. Credentials go only to your local proxy and are never stored.
query.truncated: · truncated at {{max}} rows — add a LIMIT

settings.connectionMethodText: Browsers can't open raw TCP sockets, so SSH, Telnet and database consoles go through a small helper that runs on your own machine. Nothing is sent to a third party.
settings.setupText: The proxy is not shipped with Desk-tools. Clone it, install its dependencies and start it yourself (Node.js 18+ and git required), then test the connection below.
settings.testHelp: Checks only the link between this page and the proxy. It does not contact any server.
settings.testFailHint: Check that the proxy is running (see Set up the proxy above), then test again.

detail.protocolTooNew: Proxy speaks protocol {{protocol}}; this app supports up to {{supported}}. Update Desk-tools.
detail.unreachable: Nothing answered on 127.0.0.1:{{port}}. Is the proxy running?
detail.notProxy: Something answered on this port, but it is not desk-tools-local-proxy
detail.wsRefused: The proxy refused the WebSocket (is this site's origin allowed?)

settings.serviceUnsupported: Not supported by the running proxy — update it
settings.noteListen: The proxy listens on 127.0.0.1:{{port}} only and accepts connections just from the Desk-tools site. Credentials are held in memory for the session and never written to disk.
settings.noteOrigins: Hosting Desk-tools yourself? Allow your origin with DESK_TOOLS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://your.host.
